objective.text: Use explicit factory states to cover a branch instead of relying on random attribute generation.

difficulty.rationale: Remove random selection from a test whose purpose is to exercise one business branch.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A test of suspended-account rejection relies on the factory randomly choosing status="suspended". It sometimes creates an active account and misses the branch. Which fixture design makes this test deterministic?

options.text: Use an explicit suspended factory state or override status for this test.
options.rationale: The branch prerequisite becomes deliberate rather than dependent on random generated attributes.

options.text: Increase the number of unrelated generated users without selecting their status.
options.rationale: More random data does not make the subject of this assertion suspended.
options.misconception: More random data does not make the subject of this assertion suspended.

options.text: Seed the random generator but never assert or specify the generated status.
options.rationale: A seed may repeat a value, but it does not express or guarantee the required business state across factory changes.
options.misconception: A seed may repeat a value, but it does not express or guarantee the required business state across factory changes.

options.text: Run the random factory once more whenever the assertion fails.
options.rationale: Retrying can hide a missing branch setup and still does not guarantee the intended state.
options.misconception: Retrying can hide a missing branch setup and still does not guarantee the intended state.
